symbols.docstring:
Protocol for Language Model services

Implementations include:
- OpenAILLM: GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini streaming
- AnthropicLLM: Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Haiku streaming
- LocalMLX: Local MLX models via MLX-Swift

symbols.docstring:
Estimate tokens using character-based heuristic
- Parameters:
- text: Text to estimate
- charsPerToken: Average characters per token (default 4 for English)
- Returns: Estimated token count
symbols.name: estimate

symbols.docstring:
Estimate tokens for messages with overhead
- Parameters:
- messages: Messages to estimate
- messageOverhead: Tokens per message for formatting (default 4)
- Returns: Estimated token count
symbols.name: estimate

symbols.docstring:
Check if messages fit within a context window
- Parameters:
- messages: Messages to check
- contextWindow: Maximum context window size
- reservedForOutput: Tokens to reserve for model output
- Returns: Whether messages fit
symbols.name: fitsInContext

symbols.docstring:
Create the appropriate on-device TTSService for this provider.
For cloud/server providers, falls back to Pocket TTS for local use.

symbols.docstring:
Resolve the user's configured TTS provider from UserDefaults and create a local service.
Returns Pocket TTS by default if no provider is configured.
symbols.name: resolveConfiguredService

symbols.docstring: Selects the best on-device VAD available.
symbols.name: DefaultVAD

symbols.docstring:
Returns FluidAudio's real Silero v5 neural VAD (Neural Engine) when the
FluidAudio package is present, otherwise `SileroVADService`, which falls
back to dB-energy detection because its CoreML model is not bundled.
Use this everywhere the live audio pipeline needs a VAD so the best
available model is chosen in one place.
symbols.name: make
